newsitem.title: SUDAN: Iran's Rafsanjani in talks with Sudan's Bashir.
newsitem.headline: Iran's Rafsanjani in talks with Sudan's Bashir.

text.p: Iranian President Akbar Hashemi Rafsanjani arrived in Sudan on Sunday on his six-nation African tour, saying he would mediate in disputes between Sudan and Uganda, Sudanese official media said.

Rafsanjani, who has toured South Africa, Zimbabwe, Kenya and Uganda, was accompanied by a Ugandan delegation led by First Deputy Prime Minister Eriya Kategaya with the aim of giving impetus to his mediatory initiative.
He immediately held talks with President Omar Hassan al-Bashir.
The Iranian leader was quoted by the official Sudan News Agency (Suna) as saying that his visit to Sudan would focus on finding a solution to the Sudanese-Ugandan differences.
"The fact that President Rafsanjani has brought with him this Ugandan delegation shows the seriousness of the Iranian initiative," Bashir was quoted by the state-run radio as saying.
Sudan accuses Uganda of backing rebels fighting a 13-year-old insurgency in the country's south, while Uganda accuses the Sudan of aiding Ugandan Christian fundamentalist rebels in its north.
